t: These Site Assert Safety Boots in tan are designed to provide robust protection and comfort for trade professionals working on busy construction sites or demanding outdoor projects. Featuring a premium nubuck leather upper with a breathable membrane lining, these boots keep feet comfortable throughout the working day. The innovative twist lock fastening system ensures a quick, secure, and precise fit without loose laces. Safety is prioritised with a 200-joule composite toe cap and a composite penetration-resistant midsole, while the anti-static, slip-resistant EVA and rubber sole offers reliable grip and stability on challenging surfaces.
